channel.title: Burundi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burundi, every source cited.

item.title: Burundi farmers face fertilizer shortage
item.description: Farmers in Gitega report insufficient fertilizer distribution and delays in refunds for previous orders.

item.title: Burundi football league kicks off with regional rivalries
item.description: The 2026 football season opens with matches pitting Bujumbura against Muyinga and Vital'O FC against Messager Ngozi.

item.title: Burundi team wins two matches in one day
item.description: The Hirondeaux beat Togo 4-3 and then Cape Verde 2-0 in Baku on Wednesday.
